seo.description: ULTRA OS is a next-generation open-source operating system for desktop PCs and laptops, with mobile phones and tablets to follow.

props.title: The last 30 years have been the period of computer research - It’s time to build on what we’ve learned.
props.text: Unlike fragmented solutions, ULTRA OS aims to unify simplicity, performance, and modern design across all devices desktop and mobile—under one cohesive platform.

props.heading: What ULTRA OS is
props.text: ULTRA OS will be a next-generation operating system project initially targeting desktop PCs and laptops, with plans to expand to mobile phones and tablets in later stages. Our ultimate goal is to provide a compelling, open-source alternative to today’s dominant platforms.

props.heading: Why ULTRA OS
items: We create user-friendly, no-nonsense, open source software
We reduce the development cost for programmers by a comprehensive cross-platform GUI
We create more choices for consumers
We increase the quality of services and programs for users by more global competition
We set free computer and mobile phone manufacturers from licensing fees
We reduce maintenance and upgrade costs for companies and administration
No dirty AI - Server centers should be powered by 100% green energy

props.heading: Newsletter
props.text: Signup our newsletter to get update information, news, insight or promotions.

props.heading: Status
props.text: Currently in the concept and prototyping phase, ULTRA OS is an open-source initiative to create a Resource-efficient but comprehensive operating system to cover both PC and mobile hardware.

items.a: Yes. The framework and the applications are developed in the open on GitHub.

items.q: Which hardware does it target first?
items.a: Desktop PCs and laptops; mobile phones and tablets follow in later stages.
